capabilities: Discover local Git repositories from user-configured scan roots
Scan tracked repositories on startup and on an interval
Write daily JSON activity snapshots inside the vault
Insert or replace a Git Wall section in the Daily Note from cached JSON
Show 3-day or 7-day activity tables with optional weather and moon icons
disambiguation: Not a Git client or sync tool; it only reads local Git metadata to render activity summaries and does not run Git commands when inserting the wall.
extras: Desktop-only; mobile is explicitly unsupported. FAQ, Troubleshooting, and Views docs live outside the README. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to see what changed across your local Git repositories inside Daily Notes without cloud services, logins, or API keys.

relations.evidence: LJ OS uses manual latitude/longitude settings to fetch a current Open-Meteo weather icon with no API key.

summary: Desktop plugin that scans local Git repositories and renders a daily activity Git Wall in your Daily Note from vault-local JSON snapshots.
